input.prompt: Create ONE 2K square photorealistic editorial macro product image by faithfully enhancing the attached CROPPED PRODUCT REFERENCE. Keep the small knurled center POST exactly its reference width and height relative to the oval; do not enlarge it into a round coin, button or disc. Preserve the black keyhole opening beneath the post, TWO small outer rivets, and each handle attachment and dark cord exactly as photographed. Keep the source's asymmetric pose and source perspective; do not make a mirrored frontal reconstruction. The two belt tails and endplates remain inward with their exact angles. No hands, tools, workshop scene, text, logo, diagram, measurement, certification, new interior, backside, canvas, suede, white contrast stitches or new hardware. The output must look like a faithful sharper photograph of this SAME cropped region.
